bottleneck.description: Commercial lunar landing and cislunar transport (HAKUTO-R); pre-revenue, with no successful landing to date and a contested, multi-sourced customer base.

editorial.notes: Lunar delivery is a race among several providers, not a choke point, and NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services programme spreads awards across the field. ispace has attempted two landings and lost both, the June 2025 Resilience mission failing on descent, while competitors Firefly and Intuitive Machines have landed, and the June 2026 CLPS award went to Astrobotic, Firefly and Intuitive Machines with ispace absent. It holds no scarce input the stack depends on, so LOW with high confidence. Repeated capital raises fund the next attempts against a twice-failed core capability; key suppliers are not disclosed at a sourceable level and are left unstated rather than inferred.
